ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the right-angled triangle $\triangle ABC$ with $\angle C=90^\circ$, point D is on AB. The circle $O$ with diameter AD intersects BC at point E, and AC at point F, with AE bisecting $\angle BAC$. BC is a tangent to circle $O$. Given that $\angle EAB=30^\circ$ and $OD=5$, find the perimeter of the shaded area in the diagram.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\because \angle EAB=30^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle EOD=60^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle OEB=90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle B=30^\circ$, \\
$\therefore OB=2OE=2OD=10$, \\
$\therefore BD=5$, \\
$\therefore BE= \sqrt{OB^{2}-OE^{2}} = \sqrt{10^{2}-5^{2}}=5\sqrt{3}$, \\
$\therefore$ the length of arc DE is $= \frac{60^\circ \pi \times 5}{180} = \frac{5\pi }{3}$, \\
$\therefore C_{\text{shaded}}= BD+BE+l_{\overset{\frown}{DE}} = 5+5\sqrt{3}+\frac{5\pi}{3} = \boxed{5+5\sqrt{3}+\frac{5\pi}{3}}$.

Therefore $OB=2OE=2OD=10$, hence $BD=5$. Then $BE=\sqrt{OB^2-OE^2}=\sqrt{10^2-5^2}=5\sqrt{3}$. The length of arc $DE$ is $\frac{60^\circ\pi\times 5}{180^\circ}=\frac{5\pi}{3}$. Therefore, the perimeter of the shaded region is $BD+BE+\overset{\frown}{DE}=5+5\sqrt{3}+\frac{5\pi}{3}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is right triangle ABC, AB is drawn as a horizontal side, C is at the upper left, BC is an oblique side, and is tangent to the circle at point E. The diameter of the circle is AD, and the center of the circle is O; A, O, D, B are on the same straight line. Point E is on BC, and point F is on AC. The shaded region is on the right side, enclosed by line segment BD, line segment BE, and the small arc DE on the circle. Then reason: The perimeter of the shaded region is BD + BE + arc DE. It is known that OD=5, and O is the center of the circle with diameter AD, so OA=OD=OE=5. Because ∠EAB=30°, and AO is collinear with AB, ∠EAO=30°. In isosceles triangle AOE, OA=OE, therefore ∠AEO=30°, and thus ∠AOE=120°. OD and OA are on the same straight line and in opposite directions, so ∠EOD=60°. Since BC is tangent to the circle at point E, OE⊥BE; also OB is collinear with OD, therefore triangle OEB is a right triangle, and ∠EOB=60°, so it is a 30°-60°-90° triangle. OE=5, therefore OB=10, BE=5√3. Also BD=OB−OD=10−5=5. The central angle of arc DE is 60°, and the radius is 5, so the length of arc DE is (60/360)·2π·5=5π/3. Therefore the perimeter of the shaded region is 5+5√3+5π/3.
